svg.title: Proof. If F factors through H, it is unchanged by translation by every u ∈ker H. Fourier uniqueness gives ˆ︁F(a) = χa(u) ˆ︁F(a), so each supported a is orthogonal to ker H and belongs to row H. Conversely, if every supported a lies in that row space, each character χa is a function of Hy, hence so is their sum. A basis gives attainment, and any sufficient row space has dimension at least dim KF . Applying L to the expansion can annihilate coefficients but cannot introduce a new frequency, proving the final statement. All arithmetic for constructing a basis is exact binary Gaussian elimination; no numerical rank threshold is involved.
